_doc: KERNEL-LOCK-1 (ZHC-R8, R9): the platform writes the kernel (seed/) once; every tenant pins the kernel it runs by a row here. `pin` is the git tree hash of seed/ at a platform commit, or null while the tenant is not yet pinned. The canary tenant is bumped first; a bump to the rest follows only after the canary's pin has merged and its probe passed. Read by foundation/kernellock.py; fleetmap --check fails a live tenant without a row.
